raw_segments.text: And when a man allows music to play upon him, and to pour into his soul through the funnel
of his ears those sweet and soft and melancholy airs of which we were just now speaking, and
his whole life is passed in warbling and the delights of song, in the first stage of the
process the passion or spirit which is in him is tempered like iron, and made useful,
But if he carries on the softening and soothing process, in the next stage he begins to melt
